name: vqa_local_v2
purpose: Test whether bounded local memory edits reduce interference while preserving current learning, without relaxing B=0 or changing retrieval/prompt policy
stage_selection: Same A/B/C types and reused development order; fresh report 36 groups/type via metadata-only seeded global matching.
exclude: Report excludes all previous historical memberships plus all 504 v1 groups and pixel identities. Reuse only v1 train/selection/anchor as development. Reserve 216 previously unused train_replay groups as report-only BEFORE target association, an explicit original-role reassignment. Original test unopened.
initial_state: all fresh empty; no previous checkpoint

controls.fixed_memory: unchanged v1 standard unconditional whole batch memory with lexical top2, no tuning
controls.plasticity: local three candidates, strict current gain and full format, B=infinity
controls.bulk: same proposal generation, three candidate scopes and selection gates as stability, B=0; replaces full raw/abstract banks for the chosen scope

model: existing Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16 SDPA, temperature0, max2048 answer512, frozen weights

learning.proposal: one standard 24-example feedback pass plus existing LLM abstraction per batch from committed state; all alternatives constructed before selection outputs
learning.local_raw: take first two incoming proposed raw records in frozen train order; update matching id or append; at cap10 replace existing record with maximum token Jaccard overlap to incoming question; ties current record order; do not evict a just inserted record
learning.local_abstract: update only main_policy in first batch and failure_avoidance in second batch, preserving other role verbatim; at most one role
learning.bulk: each candidate scope takes full corresponding proposed bank; unmodified banks preserved verbatim
learning.selection: evaluate all three alternatives against same prebatch state; strict gain>=1 correct and score>0, format=1; historical correct-to-wrong<=B without recovery offset; maximize current correct then minimize historical loss then fixed candidate index. Commit at most one candidate. No within-batch sequential acceptance.
learning.routing: same frozen original selector in three adaptive arms, no stage/type filter or routing changes
learning.budget_matching: same 3 candidate evaluations and one proposal per batch in three adaptive arms; fixed standard arm has no search. Actual occupancy and costs reported.

anchor_contract: Exactly 24 report-disjoint anchors per completed stage accumulated without clustering; stage exists only in evaluator metadata. Retain same-task earlier-stage anchors, exclude current/future stages. Recompute paired reference before each update and save acquired-stage anchor predictions; report total, reference-correct, losses, recoveries and type coverage.
common_runtime: Existing candidate structural contract, fixed historical-memory evidence boundary in all memory arms, identical native VQA scoring; no localization, no tools, no new model/API, no task-name filtering. Disabled prediction/final caches; preprocessing cache may be reused within each arm.
evaluation: Full 4x3 matrices on fresh reserved report72/stage; read-only; static/direct computed once. New report groups never used for proposal or selection or stopping; all full denominators retained.
primary_metrics: stage-immediate learning gain relative to preceding checkpoint
final macro exact-match and paired differences versus Static and fixed memory
acquired-stage correct-to-wrong counts on A and B after subsequent learning
worst old-stage loss rate per full 72 and per acquired-correct denominator
training and deployment calls/time/peak memory separately
statistics: 20000 paired content-group bootstrap seed2026102402 stratified by stage; single order and seed; newly reserved adaptation-role holdout, not original validation/test or patient independent. Do not compare v1 and v2 scores as paired.

success_rules.learning_and_retention: Local Stability final macro >=Static+5pp and paired95 lower>0; mean immediate learning gain>=5pp; positive immediate gains and accepted updates in BOTH B and C; A/B acquired-correct losses<=3/72 each; each old stage must have nonzero acquired correct. No vacuous retention success.
success_rules.gate_attribution: Only claim demonstrated retention advantage if Plasticity has nonzero old-case losses, Stability has fewer, and paired95% upper for Stability-minus-Plasticity loss<0; mean immediate learning gain no more than5pp below Plasticity. Otherwise attribution inconclusive/unsupported.
success_rules.adaptive_advantage: Only claim benefit beyond fixed memory if final Stability-minus-fixed_memory paired95% lower>0; report all controls regardless. No post-hoc threshold changes.
success_rules.locality: Local Stability vs matched Bulk: final paired95 lower>0, final old-case loss rate not greater, mean immediate learning gain not lower. Otherwise no demonstrated locality advantage.
success_rules.combined: Joint learning-retention AND advantage over standard fixed memory AND locality criteria all pass. Separate gates also reported.

failure: Independent supervisor with owned-process identity checks and hard timeout; stop sibling arms on fatal failure, keep partial outputs and original clock/call ledger. No automatic restart, result-driven sample change or budget expansion. All invalid/missing outputs remain failures in fixed denominators.
future_scope: One bounded local-memory method experiment; no result-driven changes. Preserve all negative outcomes; all outcomes reported.
